Name: Auto Slot Machine
Author: MonikerSmith
Description:
# Auto Slot Machine (自动老虎机)

Tired of clicking "Bet 100" hundreds of times in the Oasis Casino to earn Qi Club Coins?  
**Auto Slot Machine** does the grinding for you! It automatically detects when slot machine reels stop and clicks "Bet 100" for you, while allowing Stardew Valley to run smoothly at full speed in the background. Feel free to Alt+Tab and watch YouTube or do your work while the mod earns Qi Coins for you!

厌倦了在沙漠绿洲赌场重复点击上百次“赌注100”刷齐先生代币？本模组帮你解放双手！自动检测老虎机开奖并在出结果后自动点击下注，同时支持游戏切到后台全速运行。按 **F8** 一键开关，挂机刷代币两不误！

---

## 🌟 Main Features (主要功能)

* **Seamless Auto-Betting (出结果自动下注)**: Accurately checks internal slot machine spinning state. As soon as the reels stop and results are displayed, it automatically clicks the Bet button.
* **Full-Speed Background Execution (后台全速运行)**: Automatically keeps the game running at full 60 FPS when minimized or out of focus (removes inactive sleep throttling). You can safely `Alt + Tab` without pausing!
* **Safety Stop (代币不足保护)**: Automatically pauses and warns you when Qi Club Coins fall below the required bet amount (no wasted spins).
* **One-Key Toggle (一键开关)**: Simply press **`F8`** (configurable) to start or pause auto-betting at any time.
* **On-Screen HUD Display (实时状态显示)**: Shows current status (Running / Paused) and spin count directly on the top-left corner of the slot machine screen.
* **Fully Configurable (灵活配置)**: Customize toggle key, bet amount (10 or 100), post-spin delay ticks, and audio cues in `config.json`.

---

## 📋 Requirements (前置需求)

* **Stardew Valley** (version 1.6.0 or higher)
* **SMAPI** (version 4.0.0 or higher)

---

## 📥 Installation Instructions (安装教程)

1. Make sure you have installed the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).
2. Download this mod's zip file from the **Files** tab.
3. Extract the `AutoSlotMachine` folder directly into your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder:
   * *Steam default path:* `SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\`
4. Launch the game using **SMAPI** (StardewModdingAPI.exe).

---

## 🎮 How to Use (使用方法)

1. Travel to the Calico Desert and enter the Oasis Casino.
2. Interact with any Slot Machine to open the minigame screen.
3. Press **`F8`** to activate the auto-spin!
4. You can now minimize the game or switch to other applications; it will keep spinning automatically until you press **`F8`** again or run out of coins.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (进阶设置)

A `config.json` file is automatically created in the mod directory after running the game once with the mod installed. You can edit it with any text editor:

```json
{
  "ToggleKey": "F8",              // Toggle key (Default: F8)
  "BetAmount": 100,               // Bet amount: 100 or 10
  "DelayTicksAfterResult": 15,    // Buffer delay after result (60 ticks ≈ 1s; 15 ticks ≈ 0.25s; set to 0 for instant click)
  "KeepRunningInBackground": true,// Keeps game running at full speed in background
  "PlaySound": true               // Whether to play click sounds
}
```
